Explore the structural response of MAST-U by varying thermal expansion and wall temperature. Predictions are evaluated in your browser using a checked compact approximation of the trained neural operator.

The full interactive includes measured approximation errors and export provenance. The Uncertainty tab shows enclosures of the original neural operator at fixed display vertices.
